# Stylzo

> Type once, get 5,600+ styles you can paste anywhere. Turn plain text into bold, cursive, gothic, bubble, glitch and hundreds of other styles. Plus symbols, emoji, kaomoji and text tools. Free, no sign-up, everything runs in your browser.

Stylzo is a free text generator. It converts plain text into styled text by
swapping each letter for a look-alike Unicode character rather than using a font,
so the result can be pasted into any app that accepts plain text. 5616
styles are available in total, 100 of which have their own page.

Typing example: "Stylzo".

## What it does well
- Text to fancy, cursive, gothic, bold, bubble, glitch and symbol styles.
- Symbols, emoji and kaomoji libraries with one-tap copy.
- Browser text tools: word counter, case converter, reverse, slug, find and replace.
- A font studio that renders styled text to a 1200x630 PNG in the browser.
- An image compressor for JPG, PNG and WebP that reports the real before-and-after size.
- A text fixer, a screenshot-to-text OCR tool, a PDF page editor and a PDF accessibility checker.
- A QR code reader that extracts phone numbers, email addresses, Wi-Fi logins and
  contact cards from a picture of a code, without uploading it.

## Important limits
- Output is Unicode characters, not an image or a font. Apps without the
  relevant glyphs render empty boxes. Each style page states its support level.
- Styling runs entirely in the browser. Typed text is never sent to the server.
- The image compressor decodes and re-encodes on the visitor's device too. No
  image is uploaded, no image is sent to a third party, and none is stored.
- A re-encode is not always smaller. PNG is lossless, so it usually needs a
  resize or a format change to shrink, and the tool says so rather than
  reporting a saving that did not happen.
- There is no account and no sign-up.

## Pages
- [Main generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/): the tool. Supports ?text= and ?category=.
- [Font style index](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/fonts): all 100 styles by category. Supports ?q=.
- [Font style pages](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/fonts/bold): one page per style, each with a FAQ.
- [Style guides](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/styles): one page showing 25 words in 25 styles, plus
  6 guides covering where the finished text goes.
- [Instagram guide](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/styles/instagram): field limits and bios, with FAQs.
- [Text tools](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/tools): word counter, case converter, reverse and more.
- [QR code generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/qr-code-generator): QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi,
  email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, contacts, maps and events, built in the browser.
- [QR code reader](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/qr-code-reader): read a QR code from an image and extract
  the phone number, email address, Wi-Fi login, contact card, link, place or event.
- [Image compressor](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/image-compression): compress JPG, PNG and WebP in the
  browser, with the real before-and-after size for every file.
- [Text fixer](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/universal-text-fixer): repair spacing, punctuation, invisible
  characters, sentence case, repeated words and common misspellings.
- [Screenshot to text](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/screenshot-to-text): OCR a screenshot in a Web Worker
  on the visitor's device, return editable text, or replace a recognised line on the
  image and download the edited PNG.
- [PDF editor](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/pdf-editor): reorder, rotate, duplicate, merge and stamp PDF pages in the
  browser, without uploading the document.
- [PDF accessibility checker](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/pdf-accessibility-checker): check a PDF for tags,
  language, title, readable fonts, alt text, labelled links and form fields.
- [Font studio](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/studio): styled text to PNG.
- [Symbols](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/symbols) / [Emoji](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/emoji) / [Kaomoji](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/kaomoji): copyable libraries.
- [About](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/about) and [Privacy](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/privacy).

## Style categories
bubble (1205), italic (964), small (723), bold (482), cursive (482), gothic (482), clean (482), outline (241)
